purpose: Teach: 一色/小池/岩田/坂口/大山/山内/浜田/平井

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 一色部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the welcome reception for Department Head Issiki organized.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient opening. Short sentences. Energized but not rushed. Taking charge without being demanding. Forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。小池課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll check over Manager Koike's handover notes.
lines.style: Quick affirmation. Responsive, no lag. Upbeat compliance — showing you're already on it. Light and capable.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 岩田技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: And let's share the project progress update from Technical Lead Iwata.
lines.style: Steady directive. Calm authority. Connecting the items without breathlessness. Clear priorities. Inclusive 'let's'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。坂口広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll pull together the monthly proposal from PR — Sakaguchi's section.
lines.style: Rapid acknowledgment. Slightly faster than the last. Showing thoroughness without fussiness. Efficient, reliable.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 大山顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: We should also schedule a meeting with Advisor Oyama.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful shift to the next item. Not hurried. Expectant — making sure he's tracking. Professional courtesy in tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。山内経理の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: I'll handle that. Let me also get Finance's fiscal-close schedule sorted with Yamanakai.
lines.style: Taking ownership. Smooth, rhythmic. Showing initiative without overstepping. Competent, unflappable.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 浜田人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: We need to reach out to Hamada in HR about the new-hire training plan.
lines.style: Clear instruction. Purposeful pacing. Delegating with respect — this is important. Warm but businesslike.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。平井法務に新規契約のレビューを依頼します
lines.en: Will do. I'll ask Legal — Hirai — to review the new contracts for us.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly settling tone, closing the list. Collected, professional. Light emphasis on 'Legal' to show you're covering all bases.
